WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_NEAR_LOSSLESS:BOOL=ON

//Retain CUDA staging allocations across encoder calls.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_PERSISTENT_BUFFERS:BOOL=ON

//Use persistent page-locked CUDA host staging buffers.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_PINNED_HOST_MEMORY:BOOL=OFF

//Build the CUDA lossless predictor stage.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_PREDICTOR:BOOL=ON

//Use CUDA read-only loads in the hash-chain traversal.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_READ_ONLY_CACHE:BOOL=ON

//Expose non-aliasing CUDA kernel pointers to the compiler.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_RESTRICT_POINTERS:BOOL=ON

//Use 256-thread CUDA RGB-to-YUV blocks instead of 128.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_RGB_256_THREAD_BLOCKS:BOOL=ON

//Fuse four luma samples with each CUDA chroma thread.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_RGB_BLOCK_2X2:BOOL=OFF

//Load aligned four-byte RGB(A) source pixels in one transaction.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_RGB_PACKED4_LOADS:BOOL=ON

//Build the CUDA opaque RGB-to-YUV420 stage.
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_RGB_TO_YUV:BOOL=ON

//Use CUDA stream-ordered device allocation (experimental).
WEBP_CUDA_ENABLE_STREAM_ORDERED_ALLOCATIONS:BOOL=OFF

//Enable CUDA encoder acceleration.
WEBP_ENABLE_CUDA:BOOL=ON

//Enable -fbounds-safety for the part of the codebase which supports
// it. This expects an experimental toolchain.
WEBP_ENABLE_FBOUNDS_SAFETY:BOOL=OFF

//Enable the dependency-free experimental FPGA decline skeleton.
WEBP_ENABLE_FPGA_EXPERIMENTAL:BOOL=OFF

//Enable Metal encoder acceleration on Apple platforms.
WEBP_ENABLE_METAL:BOOL=OFF

//Build the opt-in experimental Metal predictor-residual stage.
WEBP_ENABLE_METAL_PREDICTOR_EXPERIMENT:BOOL=OFF

//Build the NVDEC WebP transcoder (requires Video Codec SDK headers).
WEBP_ENABLE_NVDEC:BOOL=OFF

//Enable any SIMD optimization.
WEBP_ENABLE_SIMD:BOOL=ON

//Enable byte swap for 16 bit colorspaces.
WEBP_ENABLE_SWAP_16BIT_CSP:BOOL=OFF

//Add [[nodiscard]] to some functions.        CMake must be at
// least 3.21 to force C23
WEBP_ENABLE_WUNUSED_RESULT:BOOL=OFF

//Link using static libraries. If OFF, use dynamic libraries.
WEBP_LINK_STATIC:BOOL=ON

//Enable near-lossless encoding
WEBP_NEAR_LOSSLESS:BOOL=ON

//Enable threading support
WEBP_USE_THREAD:BOOL=ON
